title: 305th Bomb Group - B17 Flying Fortress (42-97578) Crash
memorial_details:
description: WORLD WAR 1939-1945. / REMEMBER / SERGEANT CHARLES HENRY HILTON, / ROYAL AIR FORCE, OF YELDEN. / KILLED ON ACTIVE SERVICE / 24TH AUGUST 1943 / (CHILD'S NAME), AGED 14 YEARS. / (CHILD'S NAME), AGED 4 YEARS / OF YELDEN. / KILLED BY AN AIRCRAFT WHICH CRASHED / NEAR THIS CHURCH 24TH MARCH 1944.

In memory o the men who died on the night of 24th March 1944 when Boeing B-17G Flying Fortress serial number 42-97578 of 422nd Squadron 305th Bomb Group crashed just north of Yelden Church.
